domains.name: Statutory audit
domains.blurb: Most articles start here: vouching, stock counts, fixed assets and payroll, through to CARO and the opinion.

secondRep.title: PwC US Audit Job Simulation
secondRep.why: You draft questions on a fictional client’s purchasing process for your senior, then work on controls and documentation: the control side of the audit work you do here.

domains.name: Internal audit, risk & IFC
domains.blurb: You walk a business process end to end, then test whether its controls worked across the year.

secondRep.title: PwC US Digital Assurance & Transparency Job Simulation
secondRep.why: You walk through a client’s user-access process, write the control narrative, then test the control and present what you found: walk first, then test.

domains.name: Direct tax
domains.blurb: Tax audits, TDS, notices and advance tax: you read the rule, then prove each number from the books.

secondRep.title: PwC US Tax Job Simulation
secondRep.why: You map a company’s chart of accounts, find the book-to-tax adjustments and work out taxable income: the computation that every direct-tax level here feeds.

domains.name: GST
domains.blurb: Every month: sales into GSTR-1, credit matched to GSTR-2B, tax paid in 3B. Then the annual return.

secondRep.title: Ryan Transaction Tax Consulting Job Simulation
secondRep.why: US sales tax, not GST, but the same habit: deciding bill by bill what is taxable and putting the tax data in order.

domains.name: Bank audit
domains.blurb: You check a bank branch’s loans: drawing power against the stock statement, the days overdue and the NPA call.

secondRep.title: Standard Chartered Credit Analyst Job Simulation
secondRep.why: You help with a bank’s annual credit review of a manufacturer: its financial health first, then its industry. It is the same kind of loan file, seen from the credit officer’s desk.

domains.name: Transfer pricing
domains.blurb: You check that dealings with group companies abroad are priced as they would be between strangers.

domains.name: M&A tax
domains.blurb: You work out the tax on buybacks, mergers and cash moves in a group, and set out the options.

secondRep.title: PwC Switzerland Corporate Tax Job Simulation
secondRep.why: Six tasks with a corporate tax team whose listed skills include M&A tax and tax restructuring. The law is Swiss, so take it for how a tax team frames a client’s options, not for India’s rules.

domains.name: Valuation
domains.blurb: You clean a company’s numbers, finish the DCF, check it against peers and write the cover note.

secondRep.title: Bank of America Investment Banking Job Simulation
secondRep.why: Its first task is reading a company’s annual report (Form 10-K) and building a financial summary in Excel, and the skills it lists include DCF modelling and valuation methods. The P&L reading is the same, on an American filing.

domains.name: Financial due diligence
domains.blurb: Before a buyer pays, you test the target’s real earnings, working capital and debt.

secondRep.title: Vista Equity Partners Demystifying Private Equity Job Simulation
secondRep.why: You play a private-equity analyst who turns a listed company’s financial statements into findings on growth and profitability, to help decide whether it deserves full due diligence: the screen that comes before a databook.

domains.name: Forensic
domains.blurb: You follow the money through ledgers and bank data and help establish what really happened.

secondRep.title: EY Forensic and Integrity Services Job Simulation
secondRep.why: You work as an analyst on a fraud investigation, collecting evidence and analysing data to piece together what happened: the work that starts once ledger tests have flagged a vendor.

domains.name: Consulting & risk advisory
domains.blurb: You turn a client’s business problem into numbers and recommend the one change that matters most.

secondRep.title: PwC US Management Consulting Job Simulation
secondRep.why: You start by writing a business summary of a listed company for a diligence team, and the programme covers basic financial statements and modelling: numbers first, as in this case.

domains.name: Accounting, MIS & company law
domains.cvName: Accounting and Company Law Work Simulation
domains.blurb: You close a client’s books, turn raw exports into Excel registers, and check minutes and ROC filings.

secondRep.title: Forage Academy Excel Skills Job Simulation
secondRep.why: The first task is cleaning a sales dataset and flagging errors and missing values with conditional formatting. Clean first, then build: the order every register and close in this domain follows.

domains.name: IB & equity research
domains.cvName: IB and Equity Research Work Simulation
domains.blurb: Rare as articleship work: you screen acquisition targets and price a listed company against its peers.

secondRep.title: Citi Investment Banking Job Simulation
secondRep.why: Task One has you pick a public company to be acquired and build its company profile page, and the skills it lists include comparative analysis and enterprise valuation: the profile and peer pricing you do here.

levels.title: Excel: raw export to a register
